output_list.criticism: The totalSupply function is public and can be called by anyone, which may lead to unauthorized access and manipulation of the total supply.
The balanceOf function is public and can be called by anyone, which may lead to unauthorized access and manipulation of the balance of a specific account.
The transfer function is public and can be called by anyone, which may lead to unauthorized transfers and manipulation of balances.
The transferFrom function is public and can be called by anyone, which may lead to unauthorized transfers and manipulation of balances.
The approve function is public and can be called by anyone, which may lead to unauthorized approvals and manipulation of allowances.
The increaseApproval function is public and can be called by anyone, which may lead to unauthorized approvals and manipulation of allowances.
The decreaseApproval function is public and can be called by anyone, which may lead to unauthorized approvals and manipulation of allowances.
The allowance function is public and can be called by anyone, which may lead to unauthorized access and manipulation of allowances.
The changeNameSymbol function is public and can be called by anyone, which may lead to unauthorized changes in the name and symbol of the token.
The transferOwnership function is public and can be called by anyone, which may lead to unauthorized ownership transfers.
